risk_if_not_implemented: Without Primary Storage Site Accessibility, critical business processes and services may not withstand or recover from disruption, causing extended outages and data loss. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay (R-OR-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Transportation / Logistics Disruption (MT-26), Infrastructure Failure / Degradation (MT-27).

compensating_control_1.name: Alternate Storage Site
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to establish an alternate storage site that stores both the assets and necessary agreements needed for the recovery of Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).
compensating_control_1.justification: Alternate Storage Site (BCD-12) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Primary Storage Site Accessibility (BCD-11.2) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data Backups
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to create recurring backups of data, software and/or system images, as well as verify the integrity of these backups, to ensure the availability of the data to satisfy Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
compensating_control_2.justification: Data Backups (BCD-24) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Primary Storage Site Accessibility (BCD-11.2) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
